record.title: Cross-tenant isolation under adversarial probing
findings: Harness self-test passed (18 checks: probe completeness, evidence model, criteria integrity).
DATABASE_URL not set — no probe executed against real infrastructure.
PASS requires at least integration-test evidence; this run produced static-analysis. The result is consistent with the decision but does not establish it.

selfTest.log:
Gate C harness self-test

probe set completeness
  ok   every probe is fully specified
  ok   probe ids are unique
  ok   every criteria target has probes
  ok   postgres probes include negative controls
  ok   all vector probes target the shared-index failure mode
  ok   excluded probes are documented with a reason

evidence and confidence model
  ok   PASS on weak evidence downgrades to INCONCLUSIVE
  ok   PASS on sufficient evidence stands
  ok   FAIL is never downgraded by weak evidence
  ok   analytical model ranks below integration test
  ok   system measurement outranks integration test

breach handling
  ok   evidence record cites ADR 0010 (not 0015)
  ok   evidence record carries confidence
  ok   a breach is representable

criteria integrity
  ok   criteria are dated
  ok   criteria require integration-test evidence for PASS
  ok   criteria require negative controls
  ok   criteria cite ADR 0010

what this does NOT establish
  - that tenants are actually isolated  → needs DATABASE_URL and real probes
  - storage / vector / cache / execution → needs those services provisioned

harness OK — Gate C remains INCONCLUSIVE until probes run against real infrastructure
